description: Link Building Tool: bulk-add up to 500 prospects at once from already-parsed rows (each with at least a domain). FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. One bad or duplicate row never aborts the rest — the response reports added/duplicates/errors per row.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

rows.description: Rows to import, each with at least a domain.
